content: warren's spawn flow forwards agent.name (the canopy prompt name) to burrow as the 'agentId' in POST /burrows/:id/runs. burrow looks up agentId in its runtime registry to pick an executor. Built-in runtimes are 'claude-code', 'sapling', 'codex' (see burrow's knownBuiltInIds). A canopy prompt tagged 'agent' that should drive claude-code MUST be named 'claude-code' — naming it 'hello-bot' or anything else makes burrow accept the run but never execute it (no registered runtime), and the warren reap immediately marks it failed even though branchPushed:true and errors:[]. Custom runtimes can be registered via burrow.toml [[agents]] but the default path is name = built-in id.

Handler src/server/handlers/runs/dispatch.ts parses optionalString(body,'targetBranch') and spreads it into spawnRun options. spawnRun (src/runs/spawn/dispatch.ts) persists input.targetBranch on runs.create (guard input.targetBranch?.trim() -> null when empty) and composeRunBranch already pins the burrow branch to it. resolveContinuationRef defaults a ROOT run's base ref to input.ref ?? input.targetBranch so a CI-fixer forks from the PR head before re-pushing onto it; continuation/replicate paths unchanged. Burrow branch == targetBranch so reap needs no change. Tests: src/runs/spawn/target-branch.test.ts + a case in src/server/handlers/runs.dispatch.test.ts. Note dispatch.ts is at the 500-line file-size budget ceiling.

name: dispatch-time-project-refresh
description: Dispatch-time project refresh: POST /plan-runs and POST /plot-plan-runs read seeds/plan state off the project host clone BEFORE dispatching, so they must refresh the clone first or they walk stale state (operator otherwise has to manually refresh after pushing a seed). The single-run path already refreshes intrinsically inside spawnRun (warren-1bb6). Shared helper src/server/handlers/dispatch-refresh.ts (refreshDispatchProject) centralizes the gate: only refreshes when deps.spawn is wired (production wires defaultSpawn; tests leave it unset so no real git fetch), falls back to live refreshProject unless deps.refreshProjectFn stub is injected, passes body ref through, returns the post-refresh project row whose localPath callers use for showPlan/showSeed/plotDir. Refresh failure aborts before any plan_runs row is created.

bridge.ts runtime-terminal branch had two persistInStreamUsage(...) calls (pi-usage fallback and claude-usage fallback) fired without await right before the stream loop breaks, risking a lost/dropped usage-persist write on terminal events if the caller returns before the write settles.
resolution: Added await to both calls in src/runs/stream/bridge.ts (warren-09ed, gh-538). Watch for this pattern elsewhere: fire-and-forget persist calls placed immediately before a loop 'break' or function return are easy to miss in review.

content: In dispatchAutoPlanRuns (src/runs/reap/auto-plan-run.ts), detect new plans by ID, not by set size. The early-exit guards only null inputs (workspacePlanIds/baselinePlanIds/workspacePlansBody); the per-plan loop's `baselinePlanIds.has(planId)` skip is the single source of truth for 'new'. Do NOT re-add a size-based short-circuit (`workspace.size <= baseline.size`): a plan replaced during a run (one closed + one created) leaves the count unchanged but introduces a genuinely new plan-id that must dispatch.

title: CHECKPOINT 2: domain routes through RuntimeProvider seam
rationale: Runtime-provider contract pays down burrow lock-in before K8s; contract §3 anti-leak line keeps watchdog/budget/pause/failure_reason in the domain

name: k8s-pod-watcher-status-mapping
description: K8s pod-watcher (src/runtime/k8s/pod-watcher.ts) uses an injectable list-then-watch informer over the low-level Watch.watch callback seam (WatchFn/PodListFn injected) rather than makeInformer, so reconnect/backoff/410-relist logic is unit-testable against a fake watch. stop() must resolve the in-flight watchOnce (store resolveWatch) or it hangs when the fake never fires done on abort. status() maps pod phase to RunStatus via pure status-map.ts: Pending=queued, Running/Unknown=running, Succeeded=completed, Failed+OOMKilled=oom_killed, Failed other=error, absent pod=exists:false+lost. Correlate by warren.io/run-id LABEL never pod name. Counters (oom/reconnect/init-failure) ride shared MetricsRegistry; gauges (pod_phase/pending/init duration) read live at scrape via optional ServerDeps.podMetrics.

name: k8s-serve-git-credential-env
description: K8s serve has no supervisor, so any host-side git network op that relied on the supervisor's global insteadOf rule (installGitCredentials) silently loses auth under WARREN_RUNTIME=k8s. The fix pattern: githubCredentialGitEnv(token) in src/workspace/git/credential-env.ts renders the identical x-access-token rewrite as GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_0/VALUE_0 env vars, merged per-spawn through the existing SpawnOptions.env seam (composes with gitRepoContextScrubEnv — key families don't overlap). Apply it to any NEW control-plane git clone/fetch/push site; token comes from AutoOpenPrConfig.gitToken (raw GITHUB_TOKEN), never AutoOpenPrConfig.token whose acceptance stub-token must not become a git credential. No token → return {} → no env key → anonymous behavior unchanged.

title: Conversations backend deleted (warren-ee27 / pl-3a79 step 2)
rationale: PHILOSOPHY sequencing step 2 removes the conversations feature; keeping backend + schema drop as separate PR-sized steps keeps check:all green per-commit.

description: reap dropped_commit misfired on harness-written scratch state (warren-f6f2, incomplete fix of warren-89b0). The claude-code harness writes .claude/settings.local.json into the workspace at runtime; classifyEmptyPush (src/runs/reap/util.ts) flipped otherwise-succeeded read-only runs to failed=dropped_commit because .claude/ was outside BOOKKEEPING_ARTIFACT_PREFIXES. On the live public instance this showed ~80% false failure rate.
resolution: Added a separate HARNESS_STATE_PREFIXES constant ([".claude/"]) in src/runs/reap/util.ts — a third category distinct from warren-committed BOOKKEEPING_ARTIFACT_PREFIXES — and folded both into an internal IGNORABLE_DIRTY_PREFIXES used by isBookkeepingOnlyDirty. Kept as its own constant because the ignore-reason differs (harness-written, not warren-committed). Add new harness scratch paths (other agents) here.

description: ref-dispatch (ref+targetBranch onto an existing PR branch) can carve the workspace from a stale host clone: run_h2jmcwnkrqze (2026-07-28) started ~50min after the branch tip moved, its reap branch_push was rejected non-fast-forward, and the run died finalize_failed with the work discarded. Sibling gotcha, warren-0395: reap auto-closes seedId even on noChanges succeeded runs — a declining agent's issue can get closed with zero commits.
resolution: Workaround until warren-b94b: re-dispatch the repair immediately (dispatch triggers a fresh fetch) or fix locally in a git worktree and push; check reap.empty_push/noChanges before trusting a seed close.

description: Pi's message_update telemetry (one envelope per model stream delta, each carrying the FULL cumulative message) flooded the events table on per-token streams: a single kimi-k3/openrouter run persisted 12k+ telemetry rows (~50MB, quadratic payload growth) vs ~7 updates/message for anthropic models via pi.
resolution: bridgeRunStream drops kind=telemetry payload.type=message_update before append (6ed46514). Safe because usage hydration reads only kind=state_change and message_end persists the durable text/thinking/tool_use record; queue_update/auto_retry_* telemetry still persists.

description: k8s runs can reach failureReason=burrow_run_lost from TWO operator-relevant causes seen live 2026-07-31: (1) GKE node NotReady under a healthy pod — run_80bns4vrjsg7 had finished its work and was mid-commit; workspace destroyed, $1.45 discarded (filed warren-6c94 for salvage/auto-retry); (2) POST /runs/:id/cancel deletes the pod but the run row stays 'running' for minutes and then reaps burrow_run_lost instead of cancelled (filed warren-77b9).
resolution: Re-dispatch immediately — an identical prompt one-shot succeeded after the node loss; when a run must be cancelled mid-flight and its branch repaired, do the repair in a local throwaway git worktree instead of racing a new ref-dispatch.

name: dogfood-embed-live-diagnosis
description: Dogfood dispatch pattern proven 2026-07-31 (7 issues → PRs #695-#699, #706, #707, all merged): sandboxed agents cannot reach the live instance or cluster, so the operator pre-pulls diagnosis and embeds it in the dispatch prompt — run event tails via GET /runs/:id/events (NDJSON lines, parse per-line), kubectl pod resources/events from the warren-runs namespace. The 5ea1 prompt carried the exact watchdog.terminal_reconciled/reap_failed event sequence; the 4a95 prompt carried the verified 10Gi limits + emptyDir sizeLimit — both runs one-shot succeeded. Corollary: after ANY .seeds conflict repair, re-verify every dispatched seed's status on origin at wrap-up — this session two closes were lost/shadowed (dac8 row lost, 9887 duplicate open row won last-wins); sd close rewrites the file canonically and dedupes.
